cases.title: A chord drawn after a tangent now builds (#2215)
cases.lookFor: The last line builds: A and B on circle O, line AB touching P, and both circles stay where they were.
cases.before: The last line was refused «…סותר את «AB משיק למעגל P»…» (the reverse order built).

cases.title: The same with the endpoints placed one at a time (#2215)
cases.lookFor: Both point lines build; AB is a chord of O touching P.

cases.title: A chord named next to a diameter is an ordinary chord (#2215)
lines: AB קוטר במעגל O ו-CD מיתר במעגל O
cases.lookFor: AB passes through the centre; CD does not, and is shorter than AB.
cases.before: CD was drawn as a second diameter.

cases.title: A tangent of O cannot also be a chord of O (#2215, refusal kept)
cases.lookFor: Still refused: «לא ניתן: «AB מיתר במעגל O» סותר את «AB משיק למעגל O» — אי אפשר לקיים את שניהם יחד…».

cases.title: A named touch point on a drawn incircle builds (#2001)
cases.lookFor: The line builds; D sits where the incircle touches AB; the circle does not move.

cases.title: Placing the touch point by two point lines now builds too (#2001 / #2328)
cases.lookFor: All four lines green; D sits where the incircle touches AB. The #2001 stream reported this still refused (filed #2328); on the landed batch it builds — most likely the touch-root reading of #1820 reading. Press «הציגו תצורה אחרת» a few times: D stays on the touch point.

cases.title: Equal areas put D on C, with the coincidence notice (#1820)
cases.lookFor: Accepted; D drawn on C; the notice «C ו-D נפלו על אותה נקודה.».
cases.before: Refused «לא הצלחתי למקם את D על הקטע BC…».

cases.title: BD = BC puts D on C, with the notice (#1820)
cases.lookFor: Accepted; D on C; «C ו-D נפלו על אותה נקודה.».

cases.title: A position inside the segment still wins (#1820, control)
lines: שטח משולש ABD = 2 * שטח משולש ADC
cases.lookFor: D inside BC, two-thirds of the way from B; no coincidence notice.

cases.title: Beyond the report, same ruling: «BG = BD» on a square puts G on D (#1820)
cases.lookFor: Accepted with G on D and the coincidence notice. Two more lines now behave the same way: «משולש ישר זווית ABC · זווית B = 90 · E על BC · AE = AC» and «משולש ABC · D על BC · זווית BAD = זווית BAC». Under your 2026-09-30 ruling ("accept, always give a message") — confirm.

cases.title: A height typed with ⟂ about a point on the side builds (#2089)
cases.lookFor: All three steps ✓; E strictly inside CD; AE meets CD at a right angle.
cases.before: Refused «cannot place E on segment CD so that AE ⟂ CD».

cases.title: A ⟂ from a point on the line itself is still refused (#2089, refusal)
cases.lookFor: Refused «לא הצלחתי למקם את E על הקטע CD כך שיתקיים DE ⟂ CD…»; nothing added.

cases.title: Rectangle: the geometry forces E onto B (#2089, needs your judgment)
cases.lookFor: E drawn on B (the label reads «B=E»), with the note «B ו-E נפלו על אותה נקודה.». In a rectangle AB ⟂ BC, so the foot is B. Accept, or should this be refused?

cases.title: A third crossing on a chord is refused with the reason (#1834, refusal)
lines: AC חותך את המעגל בנקודה E
cases.lookFor: «AC כבר חותך את המעגל ב-A וב-C — לישר אין נקודת חיתוך שלישית עם המעגל.»
cases.before: «…הישר משיק למעגל בנקודה אחת בלבד…» — a chord called a tangent.

cases.title: A real tangent still gets the tangent message (#1834, refusal kept)
lines: הישר AP משיק למעגל O בנקודה A
AP חותך את המעגל בנקודה E
cases.lookFor: «לא ניתן למקם את E: הישר משיק למעגל בנקודה אחת בלבד…».

cases.title: A right angle, then an angle given, is taught as three whole lines (#2096, refusal)
lines: משולש ABC ישר זווית ב-A ו-∠ABC = 30
cases.lookFor: «כתבו בשורות נפרדות: (1) משולש ABC  (2) ∠CAB = 90°  (3) ∠ABC = 30» (display order: #2315).
cases.before: «(1) משולש ABC ישר זווית ב-A ו-∠  (2) ABC = 30».

cases.title: An angle stays whole in the split tip (#2096, refusal)
cases.lookFor: «(1) משולש ABC שווה שוקיים  (2) ∠A = 40».

cases.title: A chord's length and the arc's value are both readable (#2172)
cases.lookFor: «40°» on the arc and «7» clearly apart, «7» inside the chord. Never «740°». (The blue «נקלט. בפעם הבאה אפשר לכתוב כך: ∠AOB = 40» note on the last line is existing teaching.)

cases.title: Two stated diagonals stay readable (#2172)
cases.lookFor: «8» and «6» apart near the crossing in every view.

cases.title: «r = 4» with two sized circles is refused, naming both (#2177, refusal — wording)
cases.lookFor: «r = 4»: בסרטוט יש כמה מעגלים שרדיוסם נתון (O, P), ולכן לא ברור של איזה מהם r הוא הרדיוס. כתבו קודם את המעגל, למשל: «רדיוס מעגל P הוא r». Nothing added.

cases.title: The taught next step builds (#2177)
cases.lookFor: Every line green; circle P drawn with radius 4 (larger than O). The «r נקראה כסמל מידה» note on line 3 is existing teaching.
cases.before: «r = 4» was refused as contradicting «מעגל O ברדיוס 3».

cases.title: One sized circle beside an unsized one is refused (#2177, refusal)
cases.lookFor: «…בסרטוט יש כמה מעגלים (O, P), ולכן לא ברור של איזה מהם r הוא הרדיוס…».

cases.title: A root with a times sign is read (#2069)
cases.lookFor: The line records; AD marked 2√7.

cases.title: Area stated with «הוא» (#2069)
cases.lookFor: Accepted exactly like «שטח המשולש ABC = 6» (measured on main: same row, and the panel says «אין עדיין נתונים יציבים להצגה» for both — the area is a claim on a free triangle).

cases.title: The triangle sign declares a triangle (#2069)
cases.lookFor: Triangle ABC drawn.

cases.title: A norm is not mistaken for parallel (#2069, refusal kept)
